description:
The singer trainee Pyeong-Hwa who appeared in front of Woo-Joo, a boy who had lost interest in his twisted life, was more than anything a fun, exciting, and shining being. Woo-Joo, who thought it was enough to just watch Pyeong-Hwa debut from the side, soon came to have a goal of standing next to him. He began to develop precious feelings for Pyeong-Hwa who approached him without hesitation, and those feelings built up and built up, eventually becoming a greed called 'love'. 

 *'I wish you would never know my heart. But I wish you knew.'*

But he knows. That it shouldn't be like that. He doesn't want to be a nuisance to Pyeong-Hwa who said he would not date before or after his debut. So how is Pyeong-Hwa's heart moving now? As he learns about the sweat and tears hidden behind the splendid stage, and the other side of the world he thought was only beautiful, Woo-Joo cannot leave Pyeong-Hwa's side. 

A love story between boys with many wounds. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
